title: Godest CommandGuard
description: Lightweight command filter for Paper and Purpur servers. Block sensitive commands, control access by groups, and hide unavailable commands from tab-complete with a simple YAML config.
body:
# Godest CommandGuard

Godest CommandGuard is a lightweight command filter for Paper and Purpur servers.

It allows server owners to control which commands players can use, block sensitive commands, hide unavailable commands from tab-complete, and manage simple command groups through an easy YAML configuration.

This plugin is designed for servers that want a clean and simple way to protect command access without installing extra dependencies.

## Features

* Block sensitive commands such as `/plugins`, `/pl`, `/version`, `/ver`, `/about`, and more.
* Allow commands by configurable groups.
* Default, VIP, and Staff group examples included.
* Permission-based group access.
* Optional OP bypass.
* Bypass permission for trusted users.
* Basic tab-complete filtering.
* Custom no-permission message.
* Reload command with `/gcg reload`.
* Simple YAML configuration.
* No required external plugin dependencies.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft: 1.21.x
* Software: Paper / Purpur
* Java: 21

## Commands

| Command       | Description                      | Permission                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `/gcg reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration | `godestcommandguard.admin` |

## Permissions

| Permission                       | Description                                             |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `godestcommandguard.admin`       | Allows access to admin commands and bypasses the filter |
| `godestcommandguard.bypass`      | Bypasses the command filter                             |
| `godestcommandguard.group.vip`   | Gives access to the example VIP command group           |
| `godestcommandguard.group.staff` | Gives access to the example Staff command group         |

## Configuration

Godest CommandGuard uses a simple `config.yml` file where you can define blocked commands, allowed commands, groups, messages, and basic settings.

Example groups are included by default, so you can quickly adapt the plugin to your server.

## Free Version

This is the free version of Godest CommandGuard.

It includes the basic command filtering system, group permissions, tab-complete filtering, reload command, and YAML configuration.

Advanced features such as an in-game GUI editor, Discord alerts, detailed logs, Velocity support, web panel, and advanced group priorities may be added in a future Pro version.

## Support

If you need help, want to report a bug, or have suggestions for future updates, join the official Godest Studio support community.
